subject.title: perf(agents): cache provider tool schema normalization

question: Should provider plugins receive a supported cache-key resolution API for tool-schema normalization, or should this PR keep bundled-normalizer classification entirely internal?
rationale: The implementation’s performance behavior is proven, but choosing whether this resolver is a permanent external plugin contract cannot be safely inferred from an optimization PR that explicitly says it avoids new public provider-plugin contracts.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Refactor the runtime so embedded-agent caching can classify only bundled compatibility normalizers without exporting a new provider-facing callable.

options.title: Adopt a supported plugin API
options.body: Approve the new callable only after defining its stable contract, cache-key ownership, compatibility rules, documentation, and focused external-plugin coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep it internal
recommendation.body: Refactor the runtime so embedded-agent caching can classify only bundled compatibility normalizers without exporting a new provider-facing callable.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked prepared-runtime migration defines the relevant hot-path and provider-runtime ownership direction.
